integrity: The claim is supported by a full finite-group proof; standalone finite tests cover fifteen groups. The exact first public arXiv date is documented; independent validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Binary Takasaki/core quandle of nontrivial finite abelian groups only; no extensions to arbitrary Alexander or nonabelian quandles or constant-enriched signatures. Equivalent unpublished or unindexed earlier work is not excluded. Finite verification is supplementary and not the proof.
title: Equational probability spectra of finite Takasaki quandles recover their abelian groups
